title: Enrolment 搜尋 + 批次工具列 — decomposed into 2 sub-cards
content:
⚠️ DECOMPOSED — this card has been split into 2 sub-cards. Do not implement from this card.

Sub-cards:
- AD-006-SEARCH: Text search input + API search param (low risk, can start first)
- AD-006-BATCH: Batch selection UI + toolbar + batch API endpoint (medium risk, depends on AD-006-SEARCH)

Original scope:
- Search bar by name/email/idDocNumber
- Checkbox column + select-all per page
- Batch toolbar (approve, reject) with selection count
- Batch API endpoint
- i18n support

comments.name: Agent
comments.text: Decomposed into 2 sub-cards (AD-006-SEARCH, AD-006-BATCH) after AD-005 completion. Search dict keys (search, searchPlaceholder) already exist in en.json at lines 745-746 — no new i18n needed for search. Batch keys (batchApprove, batchReject, selectedCount, selectAll) do NOT exist — will need adding.

acceptance: Search bar filters enrolments by name/email/idDocNumber (server-side)
Each row has a checkbox; header checkbox selects/deselects all on current page
Batch Approve button appears when ≥1 selected, shows confirmation dialog
Batch Reject button appears when ≥1 selected, shows rejection dialog
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && search by name/email/idDocNumber works, batch approve/reject works.
